answer: Because the anchor count is verified against the comet text itself, the dawn audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 7 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. Filling 136 aliases thus means producing 136 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. That is 35 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
